title: 第8章 豪门千金（8）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    楚棠走的时候将那两张支票都留下来，时笙拿着支票，她这是空手包养了楚棠一天？

    本宝宝这是赚了啊！

    时笙本来也没想着真的能包养楚棠，人家那身家，她倾家荡产也包养不起的。

    不过对于楚棠的出尔反尔，时笙表示很鄙视的。

    为了符合系统说的装出一点爱心，时笙定时定点的给楚棠发‘关心’短信。

    楚棠多数的时候是不回的，但若实在是受不了时笙的骚扰，他也会大发慈悲的回上几个字。

    ——别作死。

    是的，就是这么简短的三个字。

    许父断了和南宫家的合作，不知是不是出于补偿的心理，南宫家倒是什么都没说，连违约金都没要。

    没有原主后面的作死，南宫景没理由对许家动手，因此时笙也不着急，南宫景她是绝对不会放过的。

    许母解决完分公司的事，风风火火的赶回来。

    许母是一个女强人，但是在许父面前，她会立即化身贤妻良母，丝毫强势都不会显露出来。

    时笙很享受和他们在一起的时候，这才像一家人……

    然而许母和许父意见一致的就是，支持时笙包养楚棠。

    时笙心累，就他们家这点家产，也不够包养啊！

    然后她就发现自家父母开始卯足了劲赚钱，许父其实是很有能力的，只是他希望的是家和万事兴，许母和女儿才是他的心头好，心思多半都花在家里。

    如今为了宝贝女儿能包养一个男人，这两个活宝父母开始发大招了。

    当初如果不是原主要死不活的样子让许父许母分了心，或许许家根本不会落得那个下场。

    于是，圈子里的人发现许氏集团最近跟打了鸡血似的，赚钱赚得整个公司的人都乐呵呵的。

    ……

    原主还在念大三，开学时间到，时笙也只好收拾东西去学校，好在原主以前在学校很低调，学校百分之九十都不认识她，不至于导致她被围观。

    说低调也不对，是她基本不在学校出现，认识她的，都是那个圈子里混的。

    她班上的人估计都不知道有这么一号人。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chu Tang left the two checks behind when he left. Shi Sheng took the checks. Did she support Chu Tang for a whole day with nothing?

本宝宝这是赚了啊！

Shi Sheng didn’t really expect to be able to take care of Chu Tang. With his wealth, she couldn’t afford to take care of him even if he lost everything.

However, Shi Sheng expressed his contempt for Chu Tang's backbiting.

In order to comply with the system's instructions to show some love, Shi Sheng sent "concern" text messages to Chu Tang at regular intervals.

Most of the time, Chu Tang would not reply, but if he really couldn't stand Shi Sheng's harassment, he would respond with a few words of mercy.

——Don’t seek death.

Yes, it’s just three short words.

Xu’s father broke off cooperation with the Nangong family. I wonder if it was out of compensation, but the Nangong family didn’t say anything, not even asking for liquidated damages.

Without the original owner seeking death, Nangong Jing had no reason to attack the Xu family, so Shi Sheng was not in a hurry. She would never let Nangong Jing go.

After Xu’s mother settled the matter at the branch, she rushed back in a hurry.

Xu’s mother is a strong woman, but in front of Xu’s father, she will immediately transform into a good wife and loving mother, without showing any strength at all.

Shi Sheng enjoys being with them, it feels like a family...

However, what Xu’s mother and Xu’s father agree on is that they support Shi Sheng in supporting Chu Tang.

" Shi Sheng is tired. Even their family's small fortune is not enough to support him!

“Then she discovered that her parents began to work hard to make money. Xu’s father was actually very capable, but what he wanted was for the family and everything to be prosperous. Xu’s mother and daughter were his best interests, and most of his thoughts were spent at home.

Now, in order for their precious daughter to support a man, these two living parents are starting to make big moves.

If Xu’s father and Xu’s mother hadn’t been distracted by the original intention to live or die, perhaps the Xu family would never have ended up like that.

So, people in the circle discovered that the Xu Group has been on a roll lately, making money and making everyone in the company happy.

……

The original owner was still in her junior year of college, and when school started, Shi Sheng had to pack her things and go to school. Fortunately, the original owner had been very low-key in school, and 90% of the school didn't recognize her, so she wouldn't be watched.

It’s wrong to say she’s low-key, because she basically doesn’t show up at school, and everyone who knows her is from that circle.

No one in her class probably knew there was such a person.
